title: Rollable Mat "Flexi-Roll" 12 x 2 m, 40 mm
subtitle: Professional rollable gymnastics mat for training and competition
description:
Rollable Mat "Flexi-Roll" เป็นเสื่อยิมนาสติกคุณภาพสูงที่ออกแบบมาเพื่อความสะดวกในการใช้งานและการจัดเก็บ ด้วยเทคโนโลยีการผลิตที่ทันสมัย ทำให้ไม่จำเป็นต้องใช้แกนม้วน (roll-up core) อีกต่อไป ช่วยลดขั้นตอนและเวลาในการติดตั้ง

พื้นผิวของเสื่อให้สัมผัสที่มั่นคง ปลอดภัย รองรับแรงกระแทกได้ดี เหมาะสำหรับการใช้งานทั้งในระดับการฝึกซ้อมและการแข่งขัน

เหมาะสำหรับ:
- โรงยิมและศูนย์ฝึกกีฬา
- โรงเรียนและมหาวิทยาลัย
- การฝึกยิมนาสติก ฟิตเนส และกิจกรรมกีฬาอื่น ๆ

จุดเด่นของสินค้า:
- ม้วนเก็บได้ง่าย ประหยัดพื้นที่
- ไม่ต้องใช้แกนม้วน
- รองรับแรงกระแทกได้ดี
- ใช้งานสะดวก รวดเร็ว
- มาตรฐานระดับสากล

Size: 12 x 2 meters  
Thickness: 40 mm  
Rolled diameter: approx. 88 cm  
Weight: approx. 50 kg

title: Volleyball Referee Stands & Accessories
subtitle: Professional referee stands and safety accessories for volleyball competition and training environments
description:
Volleyball Referee Stands & Accessories include professional referee platforms designed to support safe, stable, and efficient officiating in volleyball training and competition environments. This range includes freestanding referee stands, top competition referee stands built to FIVB standards, and safety padding sets for added protection during use.

The products are designed for practical mobility, durable structure, and officiating comfort. Features include fixed-height or height-adjustable referee platforms, standing and seated refereeing positions, wheels for easy transportation, and optional safety padding. These solutions are suitable for sports halls, schools, training venues, and competition courts that require reliable officiating equipment.

title: Volleyball Accessories
subtitle: Essential competition volleyball accessories including nets, antenna sets, safety padding, and post mounts
description:
Volleyball Accessories include essential components for competition and training volleyball setups, designed to improve safety, convenience, and performance on court. This range covers net systems, antenna sets, post padding, cable safety padding, and transport or mounting accessories for volleyball posts.

The collection includes a volleyball net with insewn side sticks for quick installation, a top competition volleyball net that conforms to FIVB rules, a complete volleyball antenna set, net cable safety padding, protection pads for volleyball posts and center posts, and a T-base post mount for aluminium posts. These accessories help create a complete and professional volleyball system for sports halls, schools, and competition venues.

title: Telescopic Competition Volleyball Set
subtitle: Professional telescopic volleyball post set designed for competition play with precise height adjustment and net tension control
description:
Telescopic Competition Volleyball Set is a professional volleyball post system designed for competition use, offering accurate height adjustment, stable structure, and efficient net tension control. The set is built to support reliable setup and operation for sports halls, schools, training centers, and competitive volleyball environments.

The system includes telescopic volleyball posts with TCS technology, a telescopic volleyball post with net hooks, a competition net, and a full set of antennas with antenna pockets. Key features include a net tension indicator for optimal tension during play, clear net height indications on the posts, a lightweight aluminium profile with reinforced core for rigidity, and an improved spindle system for faster setup.

title: L Type
subtitle: Large outdoor fitness station designed for multi-user exercise and functional movement training
description:
L Type is a large outdoor fitness station designed to support multiple users in one integrated exercise structure. Its extended L-shaped layout provides a variety of training points for bodyweight exercise, coordination, mobility, and general fitness activity in shared outdoor spaces.

With dimensions of 8,357 x 5,031 x 3,181 mm, this equipment is suitable for parks, schools, community fitness areas, and outdoor recreation zones that require a spacious and versatile training installation. The structure is designed for outdoor use and supports practical group exercise in public environments.

title: Square Type
subtitle: Compact outdoor fitness station designed for multi-user exercise and functional training
description:
Square Type is a compact outdoor fitness station designed to support multiple users within one integrated training structure. Its square-based layout makes it suitable for public exercise areas that require versatile movement and bodyweight training in a more space-efficient footprint.

With dimensions of 5,444 x 4,366 x 3,181 mm, this equipment is ideal for parks, schools, community spaces, and outdoor fitness zones. The structure provides multiple exercise points for functional movement, coordination, and general physical activity, making it a practical solution for shared outdoor training environments.

title: Honeycomb Type
subtitle: Modular outdoor fitness station designed for multi-user exercise and active training spaces
description:
Honeycomb Type is a modular outdoor fitness station designed to support multiple users in one integrated exercise area. Its large layout and multi-point structure make it suitable for parks, schools, public fitness zones, and outdoor activity spaces that require diverse movement and training functions in a single installation.

With dimensions of 7,084 x 6,636 x 3,181 mm, this equipment is built for spacious outdoor environments and group use. The structure combines multiple exercise points for bodyweight training, mobility, coordination, and general fitness activity, making it an effective solution for shared public exercise areas.

title: Step Cycle
subtitle: Self-powered step training machine for cardiovascular endurance and lower-body exercise
description:
Step Cycle is a self-powered cardio training machine designed to support lower-body exercise, endurance training, and overall fitness improvement. Its movement pattern helps users engage in continuous stepping exercise while maintaining smooth performance without relying on external power during use.

With dimensions of 810 x 2,180 x 1,910 mm, the unit is suitable for commercial fitness areas, wellness spaces, and health management systems that require durable and space-efficient cardiovascular equipment. The self-powered design also makes it practical for facilities seeking efficient operation and dependable daily use.

title: Upright Cycle
subtitle: Self-powered upright exercise bike for efficient cardiovascular training
description:
Upright Cycle is a self-powered exercise bike designed for effective cardiovascular training in fitness, rehabilitation, and wellness environments. Its compact footprint makes it suitable for facilities that require efficient use of space while still delivering a reliable exercise experience.

The unit features a built-in self-generating power system, reducing dependence on external electricity during operation. With dimensions of 536 x 1,341 x 1,353 mm, the bike is suitable for commercial fitness areas, health management systems, and training spaces that require practical and durable cardio equipment.

title: Schelde Sports Pro 180° Dunkring
subtitle: FIBA Level 1 & 2 approved competition basketball ring with equal-force flex response
description:
Schelde Sports Pro 180° Dunkring is a patented competition basketball ring designed to deliver equal-force flex in different dunking directions. Built for high-level play, this ring provides a consistent and reliable breakaway response while meeting the performance requirements of international competition.

The ring is FIBA Level 1 and 2 approved and is standard on the Super SAM 325 PRO system. It features an adjustable ring resilience with a positive locking mechanism and a standard hole pattern of 102 x 127 mm for direct mounting on Super SAM units. The no-tie, no-hook net attachment design also helps reduce the risk of injury while maintaining a clean and secure net connection.

title: SAM School 3x3
subtitle: Compact and adjustable basketball backstop designed for school use and 3x3 play
description:
SAM School 3x3 is a compact basketball backstop designed especially for school use, with strong portability, small storage space requirements, and adjustable height settings for different levels of play. Its flexible design makes it suitable for training, education, and school sports environments.

The unit features 9 adjustable ring heights ranging from 140 cm to 305 cm, making it adaptable for multiple age groups and skill levels. It includes a reduced-size backboard measuring 120 x 90 cm, a fixed ring and net, safety padding on the front and sides, 2 front swivel wheels, and 2 floor stamps. The system is supplied with a floor connector and offers a practical storage height of 205 cm.

title: SAM 3x3
subtitle: Official FIBA 3x3 World Tour basketball backstop for world-class 3x3 events and top-level competition
description:
SAM 3x3 is the official FIBA 3x3 World Tour basketball backstop, designed for world-class 3x3 events and the highest level of competition. This professional unit is FIBA approved and built specifically for the fast-paced demands of official 3x3 basketball.

The system features a Spring Assisted Mechanism and can be moved by one person using the APF system. It is completely freestanding thanks to integrated extra counter-weights and includes full protection padding for the front, sides, backboard, and neck. The unit is equipped with a framed competition reinforced glass backboard measuring 180 x 105 cm and a Schelde Sports Pro 180° Dunkring. Optional accessories include a built-in 12-second clock and black banners.

title: Super SAM 325 PRO
subtitle: Complete portable backstop unit for world-class venues and highest level competition
description:
Super SAM 325 PRO is a complete portable basketball backstop unit with 325 cm projection, designed for world-class venues and the highest level of competition. Developed by the inventors of the original SAM (Spring Assisted Mechanism) and DSF (Dynamic Sub Frame), this system delivers stability, safety, and performance for professional basketball environments.

The unit features a unique SAM system, heavy-load resistance, easy mobility, and a distinctive diamond-shaped safety padding design. It is equipped with a patented “Dunk Proof” glass backboard and is approved for FIBA Level 1 and Level 2 competitions. The system also includes the Schelde Sports Pro 180° Dunkring, a sturdy anti-whip basketball net, floor anchoring set, and floor hook, with optional cable integration in the top beam.
